method: gh api repo metadata + README keyword-signal scan (executed); stars/licenses/languages fetched live
axisLegend: midiIO=parses/writes MIDI; symbolicNotation=score/XML/ABC; deepLearning=NN models; generation=generates music; harmony=chord/harmony aware; accompaniment=auto accompaniment; arrangerStyles=arranger/backing-style logic; grooveFeel=groove/humanize; ruleBasedGrammar=declarative/algorithmic; evaluation=metrics

projects.description: A MIDI arranger designed to create auto accompaniment songs for keyboard play.
projects.coverageNotes: Favorites-with-Style (GPL-3.0, Java): MIDI arranger creating auto-accompaniment songs. GPL study-only.

projects.description: NotaGen: Advancing Musicality in Symbolic Music Generation with Large Language Model Training Paradigms
projects.coverageNotes: NotaGen (MIT): LLM symbolic-music generation with musicality-focused training; heavy HF stack; not style-arranger.

projects.description: GPT-2 transformer for controllable, multitrack symbolic music generation
projects.coverageNotes: MIDI-GPT (MIT, C++): GPT-2 multitrack controllable generation.

projects.description: MIDI / symbolic music tokenizers for Deep Learning models 🎶
projects.coverageNotes: MidiTok (MIT): MIDI->token vocabularies (REMI, TSD, CP) for ML models. Covers tokenization axis only.

projects.description: Free, open-source software arranger workstation (JUCE/C++, Windows). Live chord-following accompaniment, piano
projects.coverageNotes: Cadenza (GPL-3.0, C++/JUCE): open arranger workstation (styles, accompaniment). GPL study-only.

projects.description: A toolbox for objective evaluation in symbolic music generation.
projects.coverageNotes: mgeval: objective metrics for symbolic generation (Jupyter; no license); metric ideas similar to MusPy.

projects.description: Midi event transformer for symbolic music generation
projects.coverageNotes: midi-model (Apache-2.0): MIDI event transformer for symbolic generation.

projects.description: Ternary bass line generator — one of 16 MIDI agents mapping {-1,0,+1} operations to harmonic and rhythmic bass
projects.coverageNotes: fleet-midi-bass (MIT, Python): ternary bass-line generator as one of 16 'MIDI agents'; small, MIT; closest small reusable bass-pattern generator.

projects.description: Accompaniment generator for MuseScore, something like Band-In-A-Box, auto-magically powered by MMA Musical Mid
projects.coverageNotes: BandInMuseScore (GPL-3.0, QML): Band-in-a-Box-like accompaniment generator inside MuseScore; rule-based harmony/styling; GPL study-only.

projects.description: A python framework for symbolic music generation, evaluation and analysis
projects.coverageNotes: musicaiz (AGPL-3.0, Python): symbolic framework — analysis, generation (rules+models), evaluation; AGPL not vendorable.

projects.description: Utility functions for handling MIDI data in a nice/intuitive way.
projects.coverageNotes: pretty-midi (MIT): MIDI IO + note/pitch-class analysis helpers. No generation, no arranger. Useful only as IO reference.

projects.description: music21: a Toolkit for Computer-Aided Musical Analysis and Computational Musicology
projects.coverageNotes: music21 (BSD-3): musicology toolkit — scores, chords, key/harmony analysis, stream model. Covers analysis/notation, not generation engines or style arrangers; huge dependency.

projects.description: Web Based MIDI Auto-Accompaniment Tool
projects.coverageNotes: autoaccompany (MIT, JS): web auto-accompaniment tool (chord->style patterns). MIT; simple JS; ideas reusable with attribution.

projects.description: A complete and open application for automatic backing tracks generation.
projects.coverageNotes: JJazzLab (LGPL-2.1, Java): automatic backing tracks from chord sheets — closest 'arranger' idea in OSS (rhythm engines, song parts, mute/fill logic). No Korg style SMF export, no factory-evidence policy; LGPL study-only.

projects.description: Magenta: Music and Art Generation with Machine Intelligence
projects.coverageNotes: Google Magenta: deep generative models on MIDI (MusicVAE, Performance RNN, Groove, Melody/Improv RNN, pianoroll). Covers ML generation broadly; no evidence-gated rule engine, no arranger-style roles, no Pa800; TF dependency.

projects.description: Symbolic Music Generation with Diffusion Models
projects.coverageNotes: Symbolic music diffusion (Apache-2.0): diffusion generation of multitrack MIDI.

projects.description: Muzic: Music Understanding and Generation with Artificial Intelligence
projects.coverageNotes: Muzic: LLM/neural symbolic music understanding+generation suite (BERT-style tokenizers, accompaniment-oriented research models). MIT but PyTorch/LLM scale; concepts only.

projects.description: MIDI Objects for Python
projects.coverageNotes: mido (MIT): MIDI message IO (already our dev-only independent verifier). No musical algorithms.

projects.description: A toolkit for symbolic music generation
projects.coverageNotes: MusPy (MIT): symbolic-music dataset tools + objective metrics (note density, pitch entropy, etc.) for evaluating generated music.

projects.description: expressive midi generation with python 3
projects.coverageNotes: ExpreMigen (GPL-3.0, Python): expressive MIDI generation with declarative musical constraints (rule/constraint-based). GPL; constraint-generation ideas relevant to study.

coverageConclusions: Generisanje (ML): magenta (19.8k*), Muzic (4.9k*), NotaGen, midi-model, symbolic-music-diffusion, MIDI-GPT — svi su neuralni, teški (TF/PyTorch/C++), token-based; nijedan ne radi evidencijski vođenu optimizaciju postojećeg fajla.

Aranžeri/backing (rule-based): JJazzLab (LGPL), Cadenza (GPL), BandInMuseScore (GPL), Favorites-with-Style (GPL), autoaccompany (MIT), fleet-midi-bass (MIT) — nijedan ne pokriva: Korg Pa style SMF uloge/markere, factory-velocity autoritet, DNC/slap warrant, terca/echo special track optimizaciju, CC7/CC11 masking gain, groove evidenciju protiv pravih bubnjara.
Analiza/evaluacija: music21 (BSD-3), MusPy, mgeval, musicaiz, pretty-midi — metričke ideje postoje; mi već imamo vlastite gate-ove i verifikaciju.

Reuse: MIT projekti (MidiTok, muspy, autoaccompany, fleet-midi-bass, pretty-midi, mido, NotaGen, MIDI-GPT) smeju se proučiti/ugraditi uz atribuciju; GPL/AGPL/LGPL (Cadenza, BandInMuseScore, JJazzLab, expremigen, musicaiz, Favorites-with-Style) samo studija. Nijedan ne donosi algoritam koji mi već nemamo — naši 4.52-4.57 moduli su jedinstveni u evidencijskom pristupu.
Gap koji svi pokrivaju mi nemamo (u ML obimu): veliki modeli za generisanje od nule; ali naš cilj nije 'generiši pesmu' nego 'dokaži i optimizuj ono što fabrika svira' — tu niko ništa nema.
